title: Couples Holding Hands
goal: Find the minimum swaps of seated people needed to place every couple together.
strategy: Treat each couple as one node and union the couple IDs sharing each seat pair. A component with k couples needs k-1 swaps, so the answer is total couples minus the number of components.
